title: Apollo 10 Astronauts Hit 24,800 mph, a Guinness Speed Record

scenes.text: Three humans once travelled at almost 25,000 miles an hour.
That is the fastest any humans have ever moved.
It happened on May 26, 1969, on the way home from the Moon.
The Apollo 10 crew, Stafford, Young and Cernan, had just flown around the Moon.
Their capsule hit that speed as it reached Earth's atmosphere.
Guinness World Records lists it as the fastest speed ever reached by humans.

description:
On May 26, 1969, the Apollo 10 command module reached about 24,800 miles an hour on its way back from the Moon, a speed Guinness World Records lists as the fastest ever travelled by humans.
Would you want that ride? Comment below.
first_comment: Nearly 25,000 miles an hour in a 1969 capsule. Would you have taken the seat?
